tone_statements.citation: Stirtz, Timothy M. 2011. Laarim (loh) Tone. SIL Electronic Working Papers 2011-012. Dallas: SIL International. 91 pp.
tone_statements.quote: Laarim has High and Low level tone and the tone-bearing unit is the syllable. Contour tone is rare and analyzed as two level tones on the same syllable. In noun roots, there are five contrastive tone melodies in the same syllable pattern: H, L, Lh (Low, floating High), HL, and LH. In verb roots, there are only three contrastive melodies H, L, Lh1. … Laarim also has automatic down-step, where Low tone following High tone is lower than a previous Low, and High tone following Low tone is lower than a previous High.
tone_statements.locator: p. 4, section 0 Introduction (paragraphs 2 and 4); restated in Abstract p. 1 and 1.2.1 p. 16
tone_statements.summary: Two level tones, High and Low; syllable is the TBU, rare contours are level sequences; 5 noun-root and 3 verb-root melodies; floating H, automatic downstep, much grammatical tone; nothing on stress.
